children: DeFi Development entered a Sales Agreement with R.F. Lafferty & Co. to offer and sell, from time to time, up to 30,000,000 shares of its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD) under an at-the-market program. Sales, if any, will be made pursuant to the company’s effective shelf registration, with the agent earning up to a 0.75% commission. The company may suspend or terminate the program at any time, and proceeds will support general corporate needs, including working capital, Solana (SOL) acquisitions and strategic initiatives.
: At-the-market offering sales agreement for preferred stock (CHAD) up to 30,000,000 shares
